suggestions.rationale: Sleep disturbance is often documented in depressive records, and chronic insomnia may be explored alongside mood symptoms.
evidenceGaps: Longitudinal notes documenting sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance problems
Current insomnia diagnosis or clinical assessment
Opinion linking depressive symptoms to sleep impairment causation or aggravation

suggestions.rationale: Anxiety symptoms commonly overlap with depressive presentations and may be explored where separate symptom clusters are documented.
evidenceGaps: Mental health notes distinguishing anxiety symptoms from depressive symptoms
Current anxiety diagnosis by a qualified provider
Opinion discussing whether depressive disorder aggravated anxiety
